title: A deep-link Approve/Reject stays armed and auto-actions the next pending order the user opens

title: Ctrl+S clicks the page's first primary button even when a dialog or drawer is open

Owner to decide what page-level Ctrl+S should press on forms whose first primary is Submit (a data-shortcut="save" marker on Save Draft is the safe default).
